title: glosa reproduction card
description: tier: Dr (specified from founder ruling BBL-2026-09-07-229 and design/RESISTANCE_LADDER_v0_1.md §2; independently unreviewed). Methodology home P22_reproduction_ledger.md. One card = one re-runnable, hash-frozen check of one claim against a declared oracle -- the file that HOLDS R3/R4/R6 of the Resistance Ladder (P23_resistance_ladder.md) for a reader other than the maker. Field shapes are styled like review_report.schema.json and core_epistemic_structure.schema.json (both read directly while this file was drafted). Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder, matching every other schema in this directory.

id.description: e.g. REPRO-2026-09-08-0001 -- same numbering convention as GLOSA-CC-<date>-<nnnn> elsewhere in this CLI.

toledo_codes.description: Toledo codes this card backs (P19 order: the equation must already be registered in Toledo before a card cites it). MAY be empty only when status: "pending_toledo_code" is also set -- never populated by inventing a code (kernel-checked, not expressible here).

status.description: Optional. The single legal value that licenses an empty toledo_codes[] -- absent/other values mean toledo_codes[] must be non-empty (kernel-checked).

claim.description: Free text, or a claim_card.claim_id reference. What is being tested.

preregistered_prediction.description: Written BEFORE run/result exist (glosa repro new writes this block and run: null together; repro run refuses to touch this block once written). tolerance is a human-readable STRING, never a bare number, so it stays exact and is parsed mechanically by scripts/repro_check.py per oracle.kind, never re-interpreted loosely.

oracle.description: kind has exactly five values and no 'none' (P22's own rationale: even an R3-only card names the closest comparison target). source/doi_or_url/version are pinned once known -- null only pre-run, never left null once result is filled for an external-oracle kind (kernel-checked: schema alone cannot express 'null iff result is still PENDING').

environment.description: python: the pinned interpreter version string used for run.command. packages: {name: version}, EMPTY for the runner process itself (stdlib only, matching scripts/ret_check.py's own no-third-party-import self-test) -- a non-empty entry names a package used ONLY inside the card's own declared oracle computation, run in a separate declared subprocess, never imported by scripts/repro_check.py's own driver. mpmath/numpy are the two named exceptions this repository accepts; any other name is a schema violation here (schema enforces the key allowlist; scripts/repro_check.py never imports either).

run.description: null before execution. Once filled, immutable (glosa repro run refuses to overwrite a filled run{} -- re-checking it is glosa repro verify's job). ai_at_runtime is ALWAYS the literal 0, never a free integer -- the founder's own 'AI = 0 at runtime' phrase (P21), reused verbatim here. input_hash/output_hash: SHA-256 of the declared input/output file(s), computed by scripts/repro_check.py, never typed by hand.

ai_at_runtime.description: MUST be the literal integer 0 -- a card asserting anything else is not a Reproduction Card under this scheme.

result.description: PENDING is the only legal status before run exists (kernel-checked: schema alone cannot see run{} from inside this sibling object) -- matching the 'None is itself epistemic information' convention P20 already uses for X_p^int. PASS/FAIL/ERROR all legally hold R3 (the run happened); only PASS/FAIL hold R4 (an oracle comparison was actually completed, whichever way it came out -- P0 design principle: a disclosed FAIL is exactly as strong evidence of R4/R6 as a PASS).

lineage.description: run_by: identity string. ces: the P20 Core Epistemic Structure block, scoped to WHO RAN THIS SPECIFIC REPRODUCTION -- one-fact-one-home: the paper/claim this card backs carries its own, separate, paper-level CES block; this one is never a restatement of that one.

notes.description: Free text. Carries the AOWC-qualification note for R6 (P23 §1; a card's notes containing the case-insensitive substring 'AOWC-qualifying' is read by kernel.aowc_gate_check as an explicit maker claim -- still gated by the mechanical conditions, never taken alone) and any retrospective-formalisation disclosure.

allOf.description: toledo_codes[] may be empty ONLY when status is pending_toledo_code (P22's own 'never populated by inventing a code' rule, enforced structurally where JSON Schema can express it; the reverse direction -- a non-empty toledo_codes[] with status still pending_toledo_code -- is legal, e.g. a code assigned but not yet re-confirmed, so this is a one-way implication, not a biconditional).
